claims: Chuck Norris was formerly a Democrat.
Chuck Norris switched from the Democratic Party to the Republican Party.
Chuck Norris cited a shift of the Democratic Party too far left as a reason for switching parties.
Chuck Norris authored the book "Black Belt Patriotism: How to Reawaken America".
Chuck Norris endorsed Mike Huckabee in the 2008 Republican primary.
Chuck Norris supported Donald Trump in his campaigns, including 2016.
Chuck Norris explained his move from the Democratic Party to the Republican Party by stating that the Democrats shifted too far left and lost sight of American values.
In 2012, Chuck Norris warned that the reelection of President Obama could lead to "1,000 years of darkness".
Donald Trump described Chuck Norris as a "tough cookie".
